scope: Per-finding analysis of all 102 advisory matches (40 packages) from the hosted runtime audit, answering: reachability, applicability, official upgrade, safe upgrade without vendor patching.

upgrade_path_verification.method: Shallow clones of the tagged releases; every yarn.lock parsed and the resolved version of each of the 40 packages compared; pyproject pins compared.

compared.frappe: v16.33.1 (pinned) vs v16.35.0 (latest v16, 2026-09-22) and version-16-hotfix 9ad5508
compared.education: v16.1.0 vs version-16 head 22e0910 (no newer release)

upgrade_path_verification.result: Zero resolved-version changes for any affected package in any yarn.lock (frappe, frappe/ui, erpnext, erpnext/banking, hrms, hrms/frontend, hrms/roster, education, education/frontend). Frappe v16.35.0 still pins pypdf==6.15.0, WeasyPrint==68.0, pdfkit~=1.0.0.
upgrade_path_verification.frappe_develop: Frappe develop 39343b1 (2026-09-23, __version__ 17.0.0-dev) fixes socket.io-parser (4.2.7), shell-quote (1.10.0), esbuild (0.28.1), postcss (8.5.23), pypdf (6.16.1), removes loader-utils/svgo and drops WeasyPrint. It is unreleased, and ERPNext v16.35.0 declares frappe >=16.21.0,<17.0.0, so it is not a supported compatible platform. Adopting it would break the Frappe/ERPNext compatibility constraint.
upgrade_path_verification.matrix_bump_decision: Not bumped. Moving to frappe v16.35.0/erpnext v16.35.0/hrms v16.20.0 resolves 0 of 102 findings; it is a separate functional upgrade to qualify on its own merits, not a SEC-DEPS-01 remediation.

safe_override_verification.npm: runtime_install.py installs with a Yarn Classic --frozen-lockfile and verifies source_file_sha256 for package.json and yarn.lock of every app after install ('Upstream input modified' guard). Yarn resolutions/overrides can only be expressed in package.json and must rewrite yarn.lock. Both are upstream vendor inputs, so any npm override is vendor patching. Post-build replacement inside node_modules is also vendor patching. The isolated Education candidate (frontend-resolution-proposal.json, experimental_not_adopted) confirms the mechanism would require editing upstream manifest and lock.
safe_override_verification.python: Frappe pins pypdf==6.15.0 and WeasyPrint==68.0 exactly. A constraint to pypdf 6.16.1 / weasyprint 70 violates the declared requirement, and `uv pip check` (python-dependency-check step) fails by design. Bench 5.31.0 constrains setuptools<82 while the fix is 83.0.0. pdfkit and weasyprint GHSA-jhhc have no fixed release.
safe_override_verification.result: No finding is fixable without patching vendor code or breaking a declared platform constraint.
